AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Software developer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} was made to write software that would assist in brain scanning technology, working with a corporation that was investigating into the feasibility of uploading consciousnesses into mechanical bodies. {PAWN_nameDef} Was surprisingly slow and ineffecient however, never writing the adequate software to do so, eventually being replaced with a newer model.
